pages.title: Lightning Spear
pages.text: $(bold)Max Level:$(r) II$(br2)$(bold)Applicable:$(r) Trident$(br2)$(bold)Effects by Tier:$(r)$(br)· I: Summons lightning on a trident hit when raining (thunder not required).$(br)· II: Summons lightning on a trident hit in any weather and any dimension (including Nether and End).$(br2)$(bold)Obtainment:$(r)$(br)· I: Fishing (8%), Desert Pyramid chest (12%), Abandoned Mineshaft chest (10%);$(br)· II: Fishing (4%)
